hero_title: Your restaurant. An experience that brings people together.
hero_intro: Everything you serve in ZionFood, on your website. Menu, orders and reservations in one place.
restaurant_ready: Menu and services are fetched automatically from ZionFood.
disconnect_confirm: Disconnect this site? The key remains managed in ZionFood. Menu and ordering will no longer be available here.
step_connect_help: One API key. Your data syncs automatically.
step_publish_help: Publish a page or use WordPress blocks.
connect_title: A simple connection. Everything in one place.
connect_intro: Generate a WordPress key in your restaurant Integrations. Your restaurant, locations and services load automatically.
api_key_help: Generate it in ZionFood → Integrations. All public flows need storefront:read, checkout:write and reservations:create. The key is encrypted and never sent to guest browsers.
key_saved: Key saved — enter a new one only to replace it
webhook_help: Optional. Use the secret shown when creating the key. Instant updates require an HTTPS site with pretty permalinks and webhooks:manage + menu:read. Without webhooks, cache refresh and periodic synchronization keep menus updated.
settings_intro: Choose what guests see and how they order. Hours, menu, prices and restaurant rules are managed in ZionFood.
server_fixed: Connects exclusively to food.zion3d.ro. Rules and prices are verified on the server for each order.
publish_title: From setup to the first order.
publish_intro: Publish your menu in one step or place the component you need anywhere on your website.
create_page: Your menu deserves its own page.
create_page_help: Create a published WordPress page with your ZionFood menu. You can then style it in your editor.
shortcode_menu_help: Cards, search, categories and ordering directly inside the page.
shortcode_order_help: Open the menu and cart in a dialog with actions always within reach.
shortcode_reservations_title: A seat at the table, without the calls.
shortcode_reservations_help: Reservation form with slots and capacity verified in ZionFood.
shortcode_hours_help: Display saved opening hours and location availability.
shortcode_promotions_title: One more reason to come back.
shortcode_promotions_help: Show active automatic promotions; private coupon codes are not published.
gutenberg_title: Using blocks? We are already there.
gutenberg_help: Search ZionFood in the WordPress editor. Choose Menu, Ordering, Reservations, Hours or Promotions. Each block can use your default or a selected published location.
copy_manual: Select and copy the code manually.
diagnostics_title: Know what is happening. No guesswork.
diagnostics_intro: Last 50 communications: route, status, duration and correlation ID. No keys, personal details or request bodies. History is retained for seven days.
no_logs: The log is empty for now.
footer_note: Connected to your restaurant. Designed for people.
analytics_definition: Order value does not represent receipts or payment confirmation.
block_live_preview: Your live restaurant content appears on the published page.
publish_connect: Connect the restaurant and choose a published location in ZionFood → Guest experience.
invalid_settings: Check the setting values and try again.
invalid_key: The API key or secret format is invalid.
incompatible_api: The key does not provide a compatible menu. Check storefront:read access and locations in ZionFood.
invalid_response: The server returned an unsupported response. Retry or check the connection.
transport_error: The restaurant connection is temporarily unavailable. Retry using the same order.
connection_denied: The key expired, was revoked or lacks permissions. Check the connection in administration.
rate_limited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
request_failed: The request could not be completed. Please retry.
session_error: Your session needs to restart. Reload the page and retry.
forbidden: You do not have access to this operation.
retry_same_order: The order may be recorded. Retry without changing its data to safely recover the confirmation.
receipt_not_found: The receipt is unavailable in this session or location.
temporarily_unavailable: The menu is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
javascript_required: Enable JavaScript to order, or contact the restaurant to reserve.
menu_headline: A great meal starts with a good choice.
menu_intro: Choose what you love. We take care of the rest.
food_notice: Information is provided by the restaurant. Discuss allergens or dietary requirements with staff before ordering. Values marked as estimated are indicative. Ingredients may originate from frozen products where the restaurant indicates this.
open_now: We are open. Come join us!
availability_outside_hours: We are currently closed. Check opening hours or choose a scheduled order where available.
availability_no_open_tables: Ordering is paused. The restaurant has no table currently open for ordering.
availability_ordering_paused: The restaurant paused ordering. Please check back.
availability_service_disabled: This service is not enabled at the restaurant.
availability_table_closed: The team closed ordering for this table. Please ask the restaurant staff.
availability_cutoff: Table ordering has closed ahead of closing time.
choices_help: Choose between {min} and {max} distinct options. Quantities can change only where allowed.
added_to_cart: The dish was added to your cart.
ask_staff: Ask the staff for the detailed allergen list.
final_price_notice: Fees, discounts and total are verified at checkout.
cart_empty: Your cart is empty. Choose something from the menu.
your_name_help: The name used by the restaurant to identify your order or reservation.
phone_help: A number where the restaurant can contact you about your request.
fulfillment: How would you like to receive your order?
fulfillment_help: Available services are selected by the restaurant. Hours and rules are verified again on submission.
delivery_address_help: Street, number and city. You can edit the address retrieved from the map.
postal_code_help: The postal code is checked against the selected delivery zone.
delivery_zone_help: Choose the zone matching your address. The restaurant verifies its fee and minimum order.
delivery_map_help: Mark the exact delivery point. You can move the pin; the address above remains editable.
when_order: When would you like your order?
when_order_help: Now or in an available future slot, depending on restaurant settings.
date_help: Choose a future day. Availability follows the location opening hours.
time_help: Only slots returned by the restaurant are displayed, in the location timezone.
no_slots: No slots are available. Choose another day or party size.
coupon_help: Optional. The restaurant calculates and validates the discount.
order_notes_help: Useful information for the restaurant. Do not include payment details or passwords.
privacy_consent: I agree to the use of my details for this order or reservation.
privacy_consent_help: Your details are sent to the restaurant to process your request. This does not subscribe you to marketing.
remember_me: Remember my details on this device
remember_me_help: Only if selected, your name, phone and address are saved locally in your browser. Avoid on shared devices.
quote_ready: The total is verified. You can now place your order.
no_online_payment: No online payment is collected. Arrange payment with the restaurant.
select_delivery_pin: Mark your delivery location on the map.
table_order_finished: This order is no longer active at this table.
reservations_unavailable: Reservations are not enabled at this location.
reservation_intro: Choose your day and party size. We will show available slots.
party_size_help: Number of guests, including children using seats. Restaurant capacity is verified.
email_help: The restaurant can send confirmation and reservation updates.
reservation_received: We look forward to seeing you.
cancel_reservation_confirm: Are you sure you want to cancel the reservation?
preorder_started: Choose your dishes, then complete your reservation preorder.
automatic_promotion: Automatic discount where conditions are met
help_location_id: Used when a block or shortcode does not specify a location. It must be published.
help_visible_locations: Only checked locations can be accessed through the public interface. API key permissions still apply.
help_language: Romanian or English. Product translations saved in ZionFood are used when available.
help_language_switcher: Shows a flag and language-name selector on the public menu.
help_accent: Color of buttons and interactive elements. Choose a color with good contrast against white.
help_menu_layout: Card grid or compact list. Both adapt automatically on mobile.
help_show_images: Shows ZionFood images in the menu, cart and dish details.
help_show_descriptions: Shows restaurant descriptions on cards and in the dish dialog.
help_show_search: Lets guests search the public menu by dish name.
help_show_allergens: Displays restaurant-provided allergen information and the information notice.
help_show_nutrition: Displays saved ZionFood values and marks estimates. Does not calculate new values.
help_enable_ordering: Allows cart and checkout in WordPress. ZionFood still verifies services, hours and availability.
help_enable_reservations: Displays reservations only when the service is enabled and the key has access.
help_floating_button: Shows ordering, reservations or both across the site, excluding the selected menu page.
help_floating_position: Bottom left or right corner; does not move blocks inside page content.
help_order_label: Optional, up to60characters. Leave empty for the translated default.
help_menu_page_id: A published page. Floating buttons are hidden there to avoid duplication.
help_persist_cart: Saves only product selections in the browser, without prices or contact details. Prices reload from the restaurant.
help_remember_customer: Adds a separate unchecked option at checkout. Details remain on the device only if the guest chooses it.
help_cache_ttl: Between15and300seconds. Reduces read requests; checkout always verifies current data.
help_diagnostics_enabled: Keeps only communication metadata for seven days, without request bodies or personal details.
help_delete_on_uninstall: Deleting the plugin removes settings, encrypted keys, sessions and local logs. Does not delete the ZionFood restaurant or orders.
consent_required: Confirm the use of your details for this request.
ordering_disabled: Ordering is disabled on this website.
https_required: Enable HTTPS on your WordPress site before connecting and accepting orders.
frozen_notice: May include ingredients from frozen products.
clear_selection_help: Clear the selection in this optional group.
